name: Standard document request
subject: Welcome to Azentio, {{name}}! Documents needed before {{joining_date}}
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We're delighted you're joining us as {{role}} in {{location}} on {{joining_date}}.

To get your laptop, accounts and employee record ready for day one, please reply to this email with the following documents attached (PDF, JPG or PNG):

{{doc_list}}

You can also upload them, track progress and ask questions in your onboarding portal: {{portal_link}}

Warm regards,
People Team, Azentio

body:
